name: Chief Engineer Scooty

angles.text: Goblin engineers claim the Transpolyporter 6000 offers the quickest way into Gnomeregan, despite having blown up a dozen times during testing.

faq.answer: Scooty is a goblin engineer waiting at the wind rider roost in Booty Bay to operate the Transpolyporter 6000.
The Transpolyporter 6000 is an experimental goblin transport device designed to send travelers straight into Gnomeregan without crossing Dun Morogh.
Kernobee is the contact who sent word about the new gnomish rig, prompting the construction of the teleporter.
The overland trek to Gnomeregan forces travelers through the dwarf-patrolled mountains of Dun Morogh, making a direct device far safer.
faq.q: Why bypass the route through Dun Morogh?

aliases: how to get to booty bay
faq.answer: Travelers can board the ship from Ratchet to reach Booty Bay directly by sea.
faq.q: How do you reach Booty Bay?

faq.answer: Scooty admits the device exploded around a dozen times during development, though he insists it is now patched up and ready for passengers.
faq.q: Is the Transpolyporter 6000 safe to use?

sections.body: Word from Kernobee about a new gnomish rig spurred goblin engineers to assemble the Transpolyporter 6000. They promise it is the quickest way into Gnomeregan, avoiding the dwarf-held peaks of Dun Morogh entirely. The device stands ready for boarding in Booty Bay, where Chief Engineer Scooty watches over the platform near the wind rider roost. You are directed to take the vessel from Ratchet across the sea to meet him.
sections.title: A Shortcut to Gnomeregan

sections.body: Scooty takes pride in his handiwork at the roost, calling the contraption the peak of goblin engineering. He readily confesses the machine detonated about twelve times during its trials, but insists all the loose ends are secured. Should anything go sideways now, he promises the end will at least be swift.
sections.title: Testing the Rig

summary: Goblin inventors have finished the Transpolyporter 6000, promising a direct shortcut into Gnomeregan. Chief Engineer Scooty awaits passengers in Booty Bay, offering an alternative to crossing the dangerous mountains of Dun Morogh.
